name: edita-visuals

creator.name: Nam Học AI
creator.niche: Kỹ năng AI (edit video, làm nội dung, làm việc hiệu quả) cho người Việt mới bắt đầu, chỉ từng bước bằng tiếng Việt

notes: Podcast-clip look (copy of @edita.visuals, no storyboard card): the camera sits in ONE fixed rounded card (layout.card x 270, y 423, 540 x 960, radius 46) on a pale background with soft peach rays. The whole frame around the card is drawn by assets/components/edita.html (an alpha overlay with a hole for the card), so the engine's own captions are hidden (captions.hide [[0, 999]]).

Around the card: a dark pill with the AI logo and the model name that really made the edit (never claim another model) centered at y 346, the channel handle gray at top right (x 952, y 135), and a two-line call to action at y 1465 and 1540 (66 px, tight tracking, the keyword in orange bold). Change the keyword to the one of the guide the viewer gets.

Inside the card: the speaker framed vertically with the face (hair to chin) at 35 to 40 % of the CARD height, never punched in. A dark scrim at the bottom. The lower-third (speaker name in mono bold 36 px with an orange vertical bar, the role under it in mono 17 px, typed in) lands in the first 3 s and again when a new speaker talks. Take the name and the role from the video title or description, never invent them.

Captions are inside the card at 53 to 60 % of its height: a lead-in of 2 to 3 words in small white caps (30 px), then ONE emphasised word or pair under it, big: orange bold italic serif (Cambria, it has Vietnamese diacritics) or white condensed Archivo caps. Words appear one by one as they are said, the phrase swaps hard.

Every 2 to 4 s the card content changes: the speaker, a typographic card (white dotted paper, orange half-sun with thin radiating lines ending in dots, a huge tight black headline, a smaller line with an orange highlighter bar), a number card, a wide shot of the room. A typographic card repeats words that are really said, nothing else.
Hard cuts only. No fade, no punch-in, no push. No music: the original is the voices only, -14 LUFS. At most one soft pop on a typographic card.
Never Archivo Black, Poppins, DM Sans or Instrument Serif for Vietnamese text: no diacritics. Use Inter, Archivo, JetBrains Mono, and Cambria for the italic serif.

Beyond the reel (the creator asked for a more attractive, more distinctive version): a live waveform from the real voice level under the speaker, a thin progress bar under the card, a pull-quote banner at the top of the card in the first 2 s (the guest's own words, shown before they are said), a source chip and a source line (credit the channel), a slowly turning peach asterisk behind the card, small illustrated stickers that pop beside the face on the keyword (calendar, gear, loop, check, store, bag) and illustrations inside the typographic cards (people, chart, parcels, bag). All drawn in code (assets/components/edita-icons.js), no brand marks.

Build: assets/components/edita.html + edita-icons.js + gen_edita.py (builds source/edita-config.js and source/spec.js from files/words.md and a plan like plan-example.json that names every phrase, card and sticker by the words really said). Order: prepare with a spec WITHOUT the overlay media, run gen_edita.py with 'pre', capture edita.html, run gen_edita.py again, prepare again, then all. Rerun prepare after every capture. Do not put a music key in the spec (the style mutes the bed).
